$comment: Synced from mydea/Resources/OpenAPI/mydea-list-openapi.json; do not edit. Run .community/scripts/sync_schemas.py.

schemaVersion.description: Package format version, shared with Page / Section / Theme documents. The current version is 1.

kind.description: Required, strictly case-sensitive discriminator; must be list.

title.description: List title. Required, and used as the suggested Section title after a successful Load.

author.description: Optional creator or publisher of the list.

server.description: Optional service or server that provides the list.

updatedAt.description: Optional timestamp of the last list update.

tags.description: Optional classification tags the publisher writes, e.g. ["awards", "festival"]. Free-form and case-sensitive; Mydea carries them through untouched.

cacheTtlInDays.description: Optional suggested Section cache duration in days. The configuration editor fills it after a successful Load.

sortBy.description: Optional default sorting. Each entry is an array containing an item field name and an optional asc or desc direction; when omitted, the direction defaults to asc. Field matching is case-insensitive. Explicit Section sorts override these defaults.

bindings.description: Optional default bindings for the two text rows below Mydea artwork. Values match item fields case-insensitively, or the built-in fields Title with Year and Rating. The first two valid values are used.

id.description: Stable source identifier, recommended. Supported external identities may also identify an item.

type.description: Source type identifier. Mydea uses mydea when omitted.

mediaType.description: Media type. If omitted, Mydea may infer it during identification.

name.description: Parent show title for an episode item.

tagline.description: Optional tagline. Available for filtering and card customization bindings.

releaseDate.description: Release date or year. Used to generate the Title with Year card field.

watched.description: Whether the item is watched. Used to display the watched indicator.

addedDate.description: When the item was added. Available for sorting, filtering, and card customization bindings.

externalIds.description: External identities. Providing any supported identity allows the item to be stored in Mydea's catalog.

posterPath.description: Artwork URL used as poster artwork.

backdropPath.description: Artwork URL used as backdrop artwork.

videoUrl.description: Direct video URL. When present, the item can be played directly.

additionalProperties.description: Custom source property. Custom properties are available to filter and card customization bindings.

ListItem.description: Source object. Parsing accepts arbitrary item objects; provide a title and stable identity for useful rendering and identification.

ExternalIds.description: Map of Mydea-supported external identity providers to their identifiers. At least one entry is sufficient for catalog storage.
